calls.reason: OpenAI’s GPT-4.5 evaluations show substantial reasoning errors, 19% PersonQA hallucinations and jailbreak weaknesses despite increased pretraining scale. They support the ordinary claim that these problems remained unsolved, although training stages are not isolated.

Epoch’s estimates distinguish final training runs from other R&D compute, but those other activities can also pursue scale. The packet lacks sector-wide funding allocations needed to judge nearly all funding.

MindCube reports near-random spatial reasoning and substantial remaining errors even after improvements. Apple reports additional reasoning failures; Lawsen’s rebuttal weakens that study but does not erase MindCube’s evidence of unreliable reasoning.

OpenAI’s announcements document Python integration and benefits, but do not settle whether these constitute an accidental intellectual vindication. The packet also cannot establish the absence of public acknowledgement of that interpretation.
